plan_name: Flower Delivery App MVP Execution Plan

tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with users, flowers, orders, order_items, and delivery_assignments tables
Build React frontend foundation with routing, navigation structure, and design system components (buttons, cards, inputs)
Implement Node.js/Express backend API with authentication, user management, and RESTful endpoints
Design and implement Home Screen with flower catalog browsing, category filters, and product cards
Build Flower Detail Screen with image gallery, product information, quantity selector, and add to cart functionality
Implement Shopping Cart Screen with item management, quantity updates, promo code input, and order summary
Create Checkout Screen with delivery address form, payment integration (Stripe API), and order placement logic
Build Order Tracking Screen with order history, status timeline, and Google Maps API integration for delivery tracking
Implement User Profile Screen with account management, saved addresses, payment methods, and preferences
Develop Admin Inventory Management interface for adding/updating flowers, stock levels, and pricing
Integrate Stripe payment processing with secure checkout flow and payment confirmation emails
Implement responsive design for mobile (iOS/Android) and web platforms with accessibility compliance
Add search functionality with filters, real-time results, and category-based browsing
Test end-to-end user flows (browse, cart, checkout, order tracking) and fix critical bugs

risks: Stripe API integration complexity may delay payment processing implementation and require additional testing for edge cases
Google Maps API costs could exceed budget if real-time tracking generates high request volumes during peak delivery times
Database performance issues with order queries as transaction volume grows without proper indexing and optimization
Mobile responsiveness challenges across different device sizes may require additional design iterations and testing
Third-party API dependencies (Stripe, Google Maps) create external failure points that could impact core functionality
